in_marathi.name: Laksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goal, Aim, Target
in_marathi.long_meaning: Laksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Laksha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lakshya’, which means ‘goal’, ‘aim’, or ‘target’. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, is often depicted with a lotus in her hands, symbolizing the attainment of a noble goal or the fulfillment of desires. This name is thus bestowed upon a child with the hope that she will grow up to achieve her goals and live a prosperous and fulfilling life.
